summary.text: Jared Solomon is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 202 who has served since December 1, 2016 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Solomon is an attorney and Army JAG Reserve officer.

paragraphs.text: Jared Solomon earned a bachelor's degree from Swarthmore College and a J.D. from Villanova Law School.
His professional experience includes working as an attorney and as an Army JAG Reserve Officer.
Solomon assumed office in the Pennsylvania House on December 1, 2016.
During the 2023-2024 session he chaired the House Veterans Affairs and Emergency Preparedness Committee.
